title: Pelvis MRI (enhanced)
text:
Pelvis MRI (with Gd, DWI)

Hx) US 상 Rt adnexal complex cyst.

Rt ovary에 4.5 x 3.8 cm sized multilocular cystic lesion, 내부에 1.0 cm sized enhancing solid component 있음. Time-intensity curve: intermediate risk (type 2).
DWI 상 solid portion에 mild diffusion restriction.
Lt ovary: 정상, follicle 수개.
Uterus: 2 cm intramural myoma.
Ascites, peritoneal implant 없음.

Imp)
1. Rt ovarian multilocular cystic lesion with solid component, O-RADS MRI 4 (intermediate risk).
   부인과 진료 권함. 수술 계획 없으면 6-8주 후 f/u MRI 권함.
2. Uterine myoma.
teaches: Korean report: MedGemma adds the gynaecology referral (부인과 진료 권함).

basis: The record says: “Rt ovarian multilocular cystic lesion with solid component, O-RADS MRI 4 (intermediate risk). 부인과 진료 권함. 수술 계획 없으면 6-8주 후 f/u MRI 권함. 2. Uterine myoma”
Rule R031 (Radiologist-Recommended MRI) expects: MRI by 2026-06-10 (56 days).
